title: KCP application_event_emit request (DESIGN.md §11.3, §14.1, §15.2, §11.6.1 worker-operations family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Worker-surface emission of a validated, namespaced application event; emitted events remain non-authoritative until consumed through a typed command (§11.3). Registry (developer_assistant_v1): surface worker / invocation attempt only (assurance: workload identity plus invocation capability). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

fence_epoch.description: Every worker operation carries {attempt_id, fence_epoch}; an expired or superseded attempt receives stale-lease (§15.2).

payload.description: Registered application event payload, validated against the namespace's registered schema (§11.3); at most 64 KiB (§11.8), enforced at admission — the byte cap is not schema-expressible here (gap note KG15).

args.description: ctx.events.emit(type, payload) on the wire (§14.1); the SDK operation_key is sugar the supervisor combines with the invocation id into the durable deduplication key — carried as meta.idempotency_key (gap note KG15).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

eventType.description: Reverse-domain event type name ending in a major version (§11.3). dev.kovee.* is reserved for system-generated events, and an application deployment may emit only a registered namespace granted to it — a policy/registry check the pattern cannot express (gap note KG15).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
